source_Recall@10_denominator: all sentence records in the KB with the same question_id
EAC_definition: unique same-question doc_id among Top10 divided by all answer records for that question
experimental_limitations: Source-linked metrics measure return of historical records, NOT independent clinical usefulness.
MedSAGE uses question/answer retrieval channels, while baselines search global sentence vectors; candidate pools differ.
Historical answer rows have no verified independent doctor_id.
The Stage3 implementation was not proven identical to the historical frozen V4.
Same-question historical answers are retained: not an unseen-query generalization test.
statistical_method: Paired percentile bootstrap with 1000 resamples (or normal approximation if NumPy unavailable)

stage3_manifest_config.medsage_candidate: question_HNSW_top50 + answer_HNSW_top50; RRF_60 at answer-record level; best50 answer records; all associated original sentences
stage3_manifest_config.scientific_warning: This method is explicitly specified but NOT verified bitwise identical to historical MedSAGE V4; confirm against frozen original method before claiming exact V4 replication.
